lines.trans: Gabriel, I am pregnant.
It is Hicham's baby.
And I don't know what to do.
That is the crazy thing about you.
You always have something extra.
You are my best friend, Andrea.
Thank you for being there for me.
I want to buy the American agency UBA.
An opening into the international market.
It is a very ambitious project!
I will need help from all of you.
We make a real team now.
So, everyone into the pool!
We always stick together, right?
Yes, we are always staying together!
